findings.note: NHL.com lists Barkov, Marchand, Lundell and Vilmanis as injured for Florida and Swayman projected for Boston. The Bruins are without Hagens (back, out a couple of weeks) and Poitras, and Eyssimont was recalled to play.

Two Covers analyst picks back Boston on the moneyline, one saying to play it up to 59%, citing Florida's back-to-back and missing forwards. On the other side, the same page says Florida is very stingy on shots and has won 5 of its last 6 games in Boston.

Florida played in Washington on Saturday (Schmid lost 4-3), so this is a back-to-back. The likely starter, Markstrom, has given up 3+ goals in his last two starts with an .885 save percentage this season.
